responsibility: Pseudo-terminal and subprocess-terminal support layer used by GNAT.Expect and terminal-oriented tooling. It provides either stubbed implementations for unsupported targets or real Windows and Unix logic for creating terminal descriptors, wiring parent/child communication, spawning interactive subprocesses, signalling or terminating them, resizing/resetting ttys, and waiting for child status. This file specifically owns terminal/pty process control, complementing the simpler pipe/poll primitives in expect.c.
